title: RLTP Access key material (Access Layer 0.54 sections 9.4, 9.4.1, 9.4.2)
description: The two plaintext shapes the adapter produces: rltp-access-material/0.24 (the welcome material of Membership section 4 — the MO-4 pin, adopted by Membership 0.9) and rltp-access-keydist/0.24 (the keydist/refresh plaintext of Access 9.4.1/10.1). Both forms carry the registered adapter id (Access 11: linear/0.1, beekem/0.1); keys is owned and CLOSED by the adapter registration (RLTP-ACC-9200, 9360). linear/0.1 carries exactly the content key — every further secret is DERIVED from it (HKDF info rltp/v1/epoch-secret/<genesis digest>), never transported, so the log's contentKeyCommitment authenticates all consensus-relevant material. beekem/0.1 (experimental, 9.4.2) carries its key operation as bytes; Access 0.54 names no closed keys schema for it, so this transcription closes keys to { op } and is expected to change with the adapter version.

adapter.description: the registered adapter id (Access 9.4, 11); an unregistered adapter is a new identifier (RLTP-ACC-11040)

contentKey.description: base64url (unpadded) 32-byte AES-256 content key; its commitment is the multihash over the raw 32 bytes (Access 7.1); the per-epoch secret is derived, never transported

op.description: base64url (unpadded) bytes of the adapter's key operation (Access 9.4.2, RLTP-ACC-9870, 9890), addressed to the material's recipient; the enforcement operation's keyOpDigest is the multibase multihash over exactly the key-operation bytes. In the key-delivery kind material (RLTP-ACC-9897) it is a key operation that gives the requesting device a leaf or path for the helper's current epoch, verified by the receiver against the keyOpDigest of the enforcement operation it answers. Transcription placeholder: Access 0.54 names no closed keys schema for beekem/0.1
